stack.notes: A library, not an app: fleet apps consume src/ as raw TypeScript; dist/app-shell.js is a prebuilt ESM bundle (bun build) for no-bundler pages.

styling.notes: Each UI module injects its own scoped <style> once (nq-cc-*, nq-fb-* classes and --nq-cc-* tokens). No @nimiq/style import; the host page owns fonts and global CSS.

settlement.notes: Does not settle. Vendors excerpts of nimiq-settlement (signed-message verify, RPC endpoint list) under src/vendor/settlement; balance and validity reads go over public RPC.

deploy.notes: Not deployed. Consumers pin a git tag; jsdelivr serves dist/ from the tag. CI runs typecheck, tests and the bundle build only.

config.notes: fileSizeGuard stays off: src/ui/corner-control.ts is 2,633 lines, so an 800-line guard would fail on main.
